en: Complex and advanced in design; or having wide experience and good taste.
ex: The company uses sophisticated software to track sales.
公司使用精密的軟體追蹤銷售。

en: The way of showing things as they really are; or the attitude of being practical.
ex: The novel is known for its stark realism.
這部小說以其嚴峻的寫實風格聞名。

en: The food and substances your body needs to grow and stay healthy; or the study of this.
ex: Good nutrition is important for growing children.
良好的營養對成長中的孩子很重要。

en: A long journey made for a particular purpose such as exploration; or the people who go on it.
ex: The expedition set out to climb the highest peak.
探險隊出發去攀登最高峰。

en: An agreement between people or countries; or to give someone something as a right.
ex: The two nations signed a peace accord last week.
兩國上週簽署了和平協定。

en: The place where someone or something is going.
ex: Bali is a popular tourist destination.
峇里島是熱門的旅遊目的地。

en: Relating to the voice; or expressing opinions loudly and openly.
ex: She is very vocal about her political views.
她對自己的政治觀點直言不諱。

en: A person sent to a foreign place to teach a religion or do charity work.
ex: The missionary spent twenty years teaching in Africa.
那位傳教士在非洲教書二十年。

en: Relating to a residential area on the edge of a city; or dull and narrow-minded.
ex: They moved to a quiet suburban neighborhood.
他們搬到了安靜的郊區社區。

en: A person who is believed to speak for God; or someone who predicts the future.
ex: The prophet warned the people of a coming disaster.
先知警告人們災難即將降臨。

en: An organization for research or education; or to start a system or rule.
ex: She works at a research institute in Taipei.
她在台北的一家研究機構工作。

en: A long gun fired from the shoulder; or to search through something quickly.
ex: He rifled through the drawer looking for his keys.
他在抽屜裡翻找鑰匙。

en: Very strange and unusual, often in a frightening way.
ex: I heard a weird noise coming from the attic.
我聽到閣樓傳來怪聲。

en: The quality of being useful; or a service such as water, gas or electricity.
ex: The utility company raised its rates this month.
公用事業公司本月調漲了費率。

en: The act of formally suggesting someone for a job, role or prize.
ex: The film received five Oscar nominations.
這部電影獲得五項奧斯卡提名。

en: A journalist who reports news from a distant place; or someone who writes letters regularly.
ex: The BBC correspondent reported live from the scene.
BBC 記者從現場進行直播報導。

en: The act of obeying a rule, law or request.
ex: All buildings must be in compliance with safety rules.
所有建築都必須符合安全規定。

en: An explanation of the meaning of something; or the way an artist performs a piece.
ex: There are many interpretations of the poem.
這首詩有許多不同的解讀。

en: A person who supports communism or belongs to a communist party.
ex: He was a communist during the Cold War.
冷戰期間他是一名共產黨員。

en: To make someone want to do something, especially something wrong or unwise.
ex: I was tempted to buy the expensive jacket.
我很想買那件昂貴的夾克。

en: A person who regularly travels some distance to work.
ex: Thousands of commuters use this station every day.
每天有數千名通勤者使用這個車站。

en: To receive money or property from someone who has died; or to get a quality from your parents.
ex: She inherited her mother's beautiful singing voice.
她遺傳了母親美妙的歌聲。

en: Based on reason rather than emotion; sensible.
ex: There must be a rational explanation for this.
這件事一定有合理的解釋。

en: The quality of being new and different, not copied from others.
ex: The designer is praised for her originality.
那位設計師因其獨創性而受到讚揚。

en: A tube carrying blood to the heart; also a streak of mineral in rock, or a particular mood.
ex: The nurse found a vein to draw blood from.
護理師找到一條靜脈來抽血。

en: Something that may be dangerous or cause damage; or to make a guess at the risk of being wrong.
ex: Loose wires are a serious fire hazard.
鬆脫的電線是嚴重的火災隱患。

en: Meant to be kept secret; or trusting and ready to tell secrets.
ex: Please keep this information strictly confidential.
請對這項資訊嚴格保密。

en: To look at something carefully; to read quickly; or to use a machine to copy an image.
ex: She scanned the document and emailed it to me.
她掃描了文件並用電子郵件寄給我。

en: Belonging to the present time; or living at the same time as someone else.
ex: The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
博物館有大量當代藝術收藏。

en: The sending of something from one place to another; or the gears of a car.
ex: The virus spreads through direct transmission.
病毒透過直接傳播擴散。

en: A public festival with music, dancing and street parades.
ex: Thousands of people joined the carnival parade.
數千人參加了嘉年華遊行。

en: To travel regularly between home and work; or to change a punishment to a lighter one.
ex: She commutes to Taipei by train every day.
她每天搭火車通勤到台北。

en: The situation of being forced to live outside your own country; or to send someone away from their country.
ex: The former leader lived in exile for many years.
這位前領導人流亡多年。

en: A very strong, unpleasant smell; or to smell very bad.
ex: The rotten eggs stank up the whole kitchen.
腐壞的蛋讓整個廚房臭氣沖天。

en: To continue to do something in spite of difficulty; or to continue to exist.
ex: If the pain persists, see a doctor.
如果疼痛持續，請去看醫生。

en: A long, loud cry made by a dog, wolf or a person in pain or anger; or to make such a sound.
ex: We heard wolves howling in the distance.
我們聽到遠處有狼在嚎叫。

en: A holiday on a large ship; or to travel smoothly at a steady speed.
ex: They went on a two-week cruise around the Caribbean.
他們去加勒比海進行了為期兩週的郵輪旅行。

en: Able to continue over a long time without harming the environment or running out.
ex: The city wants to build a more sustainable economy.
這座城市想建立更具永續性的經濟。

en: To give a lot of your time and effort to something; or to name a book or song as a tribute to someone.
ex: She dedicated her life to helping the poor.
她把一生奉獻給幫助窮人。

en: A large building where goods are stored before being sold or sent out.
ex: The goods are kept in a warehouse near the port.
貨物存放在港口附近的倉庫裡。
